name: todo-vault
description: Local-first, Jira-shaped task vault with an MCP server so any Claude can read and write it

scripts.//test: Globs, as the root and apps/desktop do. It named test/vault.test.ts alone until there was a second test file, at which point a single name is not a suite — it is a suite that silently ignores everything added to it. The glob is why this workspace needs Node 22: npm hands scripts to cmd.exe on Windows, cmd.exe does not expand globs, and Node only learned to expand the pattern itself in 22. The engines floor here was already >=22 for agreement with the root; this is what makes it load-bearing.

//engines: Matches the root, which moved to >=22 when the first CI run disproved >=20. Unlike the root and apps/desktop, this workspace's own `test` script names a single file rather than a glob, so 20 was never disproven *here* — it is corrected for agreement rather than because this suite was seen to fail. Two manifests disagreeing about the floor is a claim nobody can act on, and the root's is the one CI actually exercises.
